parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat of a folding chair, made of polypropylene plastic, typically flat and rectangular in shape, providing the sitting surface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user's weight and provides a comfortable surface to sit on. It is attached to the folding frame and may pivot slightly when the chair is folded or unfolded.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly during folding and unfolding but remains fixed during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the folding chair, made of tubular steel, forming the structural support and folding mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity, supports the seat and backrest, and allows the chair to fold for storage or transport.
parts.Movement_description: It includes pivot joints that enable folding and unfolding motion, with legs and backrest moving relative to each other.
